summary.en: Just as Kogoro's luck seems to be running out after a bad day at the horse races with a revenge fueled escaped con bearing down on him, a beautiful woman practically falls into his arms. The only problem is, she can't remember a thing about herself, except her name. Can Kogoro help this woman regain her memory and, if so, will it only get him into more trouble than he's already in?

locations: In front of Beika Grand Hotel

victims.name: Kogoro Mouri and Maya Tachibana
victims.nameZh: 毛利小五郎与立花真夜
